notes: Drafting explicitly uses gpt-6.1-sol with high reasoning effort; review, revisions and re-review explicitly use gpt-6-astra with high reasoning effort.
The controller uses actual model-selectable child-agent calls. This JSON is a policy, not a model invocation.
Freeze this policy and the rule version/hash in each batch. Do not silently apply later global changes to an active batch.
Dispatch logs are controller-captured records; field validation cannot independently attest that a model executed.
Controller defer events may record failures or missing input, but must never claim a successful model dispatch or review.
New batches use parallel_batch.py. Existing serial batches retain their frozen policy and batch_tool.py.
Capacity is the actual available child-worker count, excluding the controller and unrelated running workers; never infer it from target_workers.
Separate project and attempt directories; one active stage per project. Refill free slots and keep review/revision progressing.
Deliver each accepted case immediately to the same desktop batch folder while other workers continue. Partial delivery must not close the batch; preserve prior outputs and update the delivery ledger.
